tasks.gr11-xho-listening-t4: Topic: Revision of speeches, listening comprehension, reading fluency, and presentation review. Cover speech structure revision for final assessment, listening comprehension strategies under exam conditions, reading fluency markers (pace, pronunciation, expression), and reviewing oral presentation performance. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to recall speech components, apply listening strategies, identify fluency indicators, and self-evaluate an oral presentation.
tasks.gr11-xho-reading-t4: Topic: Revision across literature, media texts, comprehension, and summary. Cover literature revision focusing on themes, characters, and quotation use, Paper 1 comprehension skills (summarising, inference, vocabulary), visual text revision, and summary writing techniques. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to select relevant quotations, apply comprehension strategies, interpret visual texts, and write accurate summaries.
tasks.gr11-xho-writing-t4: Topic: Exam essays, transactional text recall, report and review writing, and proofreading. Cover planning and writing under timed exam conditions, quick recall of transactional text formats, revising report and review structures, and systematic proofreading and editing. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to plan an exam essay efficiently, identify transactional format elements, revise a report for errors, and apply proofreading strategies.
tasks.gr11-xho-language-t4: Topic: Revision of all major grammar points, editing, sentence control, and punctuation. Cover concord and tense revision, passive voice and reported speech, sentence variety and control, and punctuation accuracy for final assessment. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to correct concord errors, identify tense shifts, improve sentence variety, and punctuate accurately in examination-style tasks.
